subject: Latent Growth Curve Model, But Time Between Waves Not Discrete

messages.author: afad425dd9c86301
messages.subject: Latent Growth Curve Model, But Time Between Waves Not Discrete
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to create a simple latent growth curve model, but each wave of the data I am using was not collected at regular intervals. For example, some waves are separated by 1 month while others are separated by 4.

Is there any way to deal with continuous-time intervals in lavaan? Specifically in a LGC context?

Thanks in advance,

Jack

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Latent Growth Curve Model, But Time Between Waves Not Discrete
parts: Of course. Instead of using slope loadings reflecting equal time intervals, use slope loadings that reflect different time intervals. If test 1 happens at time 0 and test 2 happens at time 4, then set loadings of 0*t1 and 4*t2. You will need to choose and set these values yourself. Bear in mind that your choice of starting point (your choice of a time 0 period) will make a difference in some of your results.
